title: Chapter 34 Waterproof Sky Curtain
content:
Chapter 34 Waterproof Sky Curtain

He looked at his backpack and found that he was really short of money.

There were not many things he could afford now, so he had to be frugal.

As for those good skills and cultivation methods, he would consider them after he had overcome the flood crisis!

In desperation, Wang Shuo had to choose the items that he needed most urgently at the moment.

A defensive item called "Waterproof Sky Curtain" and "Energy Converter".

Both of these things were urgently needed by Wang Shuo, but they were not cheap.

The energy converter cost 500 gold coins, while the "Waterproof Sky Curtain" was even more expensive, requiring 1,000 gold coins.

Hadro had also experienced the novice trial, and he implicitly revealed that the scale of the upcoming flood would definitely exceed Wang Shuo's cognition.

At the same time, he reminded Wang Shuo that during the trial, he must maximize his strength so that he could be in an advantageous position and not be eliminated.

The trial stage is changing rapidly, and it is normal for latecomers to be ahead!

Wang Shuo thought about it and felt that what Hadro said made sense. It seemed that he had to buy it.

But he didn't have enough gold coins now.

"Mr. Hadro, I wonder if you would accept these things?" Wang Shuo directly talked about the materials he currently had.

"Energy crystals, this is a better hard currency than gold coins, and soul crystals, this is even more valuable."

Wang Shuo realized the value of these two things.

Even outside the trial space, soul crystals are rare and good things.

Wang Shuo was confident, and suddenly Wang Shuo thought of something and asked: "Mr. Hadro, do you have a purification scroll here?"

"Of course I have this kind of thing, it is a must-have for mercenaries." As he said, Hadro took out a scroll from a drawer.

Then Wang Shuo asked again: "Do you have fine iron, mithril, ironwood, and fire rune enchantment?"

"Lord, do you want to make equipment?"

"Yes."

Hadro laughed and said: "Lord, I do have one ironwood, but I don't have fine iron and mithril for the time being. However, as far as I know, the fire rune enchantment must be made by a blacksmith. May I ask, Lord, is it a blacksmith?"

"Ah!" Wang Shuo was surprised. It seems that even if he gathered all the materials, he couldn't make it.

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo couldn't help but feel a little disappointed.

"Lord, I have another thing, I'm sure you will like it."

As he said, he took out a scroll from a box on the shelf.

"Thought Stamp Scroll."

[Thought Stamp: A means used by lords to control refugees. It can forcibly implant an irresistible thought in the soul of others, which requires both parties to be willing. 】

This is indeed a good thing. As a lord, you must accept refugees, and how to ensure their loyalty is a big problem that many lords have a headache about.

Shaoqing, Wang Shuo has chosen the goods.

The most expensive water-proof sky-shading curtain needs to be exchanged for a soul crystal, and the others are paid with gold coins.

[Energy converter +1, water-proof sky-shading curtain +1, iron wood +1, purification scroll +1, thought steel stamp scroll +1, soul crystal -1, gold coins -1200. 】

The two parties reached a deal. Before Hadro left, he gave Wang Shuo another summoning scroll for the traveling merchant. This summoning scroll is a designated summoning, which means that it can only summon Hadro.

Wang Shuo is now one of his customers.

Hadro put away the attic and opened a light gate again. This light gate is very similar to the starry sky gate in the void battlefield.

Seeing the portal in front of him, Wang Shuo wondered if he could pass through this light gate and leave this novice trial space.

As if seeing through Wang Shuo's thoughts, Hadro said: "Lord, you are now in the protection period of novice training, and you cannot go to our big world."

Wang Shuo still did not give up, took a step forward, and found that he could not enter the light gate.

"Well, Mr. Hadro, goodbye. I look forward to seeing you next time!"

Wang Shuo's farewell was like a promise with himself that he must live until the next meeting.

"As you wish, Lord, I look forward to seeing you again."

Hadro said, rode on the camel, walked into the light gate, and disappeared!

After a few seconds, the light gate also disappeared, as if it had never appeared.

But just a few minutes ago, while the two were not paying attention, a little thing ran out of Hadro's attic, and in the blink of an eye, it hid in Wang Shuo's territory.

In the sky, thick clouds rolled, with a momentum of black clouds pressing down on the city and destroying it.

Now that the key items to upgrade the shelter were in hand, Wang Shuo hurried to the brick kiln to make fire bricks and tiles.

It would be best if the shelter could be upgraded to another level before the flood came.

When the fire in the brick kiln was burning again, Wang Shuo returned to the shelter and ordered takeout from Chef Zhang.

He opened the [Chat Channel] and began to browse other players' chat messages.

"It's getting dark, it looks like it's going to rain heavily!"

"My shelter is in a depression, what should I do?"

"Haha, I'm on the top of a mountain, let the storm come harder!"

"Is there any humanity upstairs! You are gloating over other people's misfortunes, and you will not die well!"

Wang Shuo looked at the trading house again.

There are more and more people selling bronze keys, and the price has dropped to 1 gold and 50 silver.

Some of Wang Shuo's bronze keys are not selling well.

It seems that this business will not last long.

"Should I sell bronze key molds directly?" Wang Shuo had such an idea in his mind.

To upgrade the courtyard, Wang Shuo still lacks a lot of gold coins and resources, and he must quickly recover a batch of funds.

He did it right away. He saw that there were more than 100 pieces of wood, so he made 100 sets of bronze key molds, each set of 10.

At the price of 50 gold coins, he directly put it on the trading line.

He wanted to advertise in the [Chat Channel], but thought about it and didn't do it.

This would easily cause hostility from other key sellers.

After a while, several players bought Wang Shuo's bronze key molds. It is better to make them by yourself than to keep buying them. After all, this is a once-and-for-all thing.

I checked the upgrade conditions: 2000 wood + 10,000 fire bricks + 20,000 blue tiles + 2000 stone + 20 energy crystals + 200 iron ore + 100 gold coins + energy converter.

Fire bricks and blue tiles are already being made, and some stone and wood are still needed.

At this time, gold coins are also arriving one after another. Wang Shuo directly bought 5000 wood and 5000 stone. After the flood, I don’t know what will happen. It’s better to prepare more resources first.

[Wood +5000, Stone +5000, Gold Coins -12]

The price of wood and stone is currently stable at around 10 copper coins. Since Wang Shuo bought a lot of goods, he still bought some at a high price, but Wang Shuo no longer cares about this little bit of copper coins.

[Coal +5000, Gold Coins -22]

The amount of coal used is also very huge.

Before, he bought as much as he needed. This time, Wang Shuo directly bought more.

Looking at the time, it would take more than an hour for the bricks and tiles to be fired.

Wang Shuo planned to make another 4,000 iron arrows in case of emergency. After all, it would take 1,000 iron arrows to fill the arrow tower once.

[100 (iron) arrows = wood 5113/1, iron ore 700/10, coal 5000/10, feather 500/10]

[iron arrows +4000, wood -40, iron ore -400, coal -400, feather -400]

For the current territory defense, the arrow tower can be said to be the most efficient.

Wang Shuo directly put 2,000 iron arrows into the arrow tower, but found that the arrow tower at the door had lost more than half of its durability.

This scared Wang Shuo.
